name: Protector Tree
rationale: Oak and Nature grow the body, while a seal, living light and honey shelter neighboring allies.

parts.rationale: Native healing ingredient; optional Iron Holy focus

clues: Outer Plinths hold oak motif, living light; the other required ingredients use Inner Plinths.
Leave the second outer Plinth clockwise from Paper empty.
Leave the fourth outer Plinth clockwise from Paper empty.
Oak motif follows blank inscription clockwise.
Nature focus follows oak motif clockwise.
Protection seal follows nature focus clockwise, across an unused outer Plinth.
Living light follows protection seal clockwise.
Honey motif follows living light clockwise.
Blank inscription follows honey motif clockwise, across an unused outer Plinth.
